chapter: Sam Morgan, repertoire and Silver Leaf
title: Perez's band: repertoire of reading bands, waltzes, quadrilles and polkas
summary: A reading band played ragtime, waltzes, schottisches, quadrilles and polkas, whereas Sam Morgan played mostly popular songs.
